column6: (word & 0x3f) << 2 from the caller _gleBuildVertexFuncNO: the byte displacement from the destination base register r5 in every emitted store (0x9005xxxx stw, 0xb005 sth, 0x9805 stb, 0xd025 stfs ... disp(r5)); also advanced by 2/3 for the narrow stores of the byte-order variants
(src word >> 14) + 1 in the caller: 1..4 components of the loaded element; every path switches on it (1..4) and fills missing components when it is less than destComponentCount
element type code from the caller (src word >> 10 & 0xf): 8/9 select the byte-normalised defaults 0x7f/0xff and 10/11 the 16-bit defaults 0x7fff/0xffff for a missing fourth component
selects the store width: 1 emits byte stores (stb), 2 halfword stores (sth), 0 or 4 floating-point stores (stfs, stfd when 4); the caller passes 0, 1, 2 or 4
(dest word >> 8 & 3) + 1 in the caller (5 when the 4-component dest has the extra slot): number of components to store, 1..5; tested against srcComponentCount to add default fills

flags word passed by the caller (its uStack_d0 or bit 21 of it): bit 20 (0x100000) and bit 21 (0x200000) are tested: bit 20 chooses between the two emission orders of the integer paths, bit 21 gates the trailing float store at +8/+0xc
